name: Autoneum Holding AG
summary: Autoneum Holding AG develops and manufactures acoustic and thermal management solutions for light and commercial vehicles. It offers multifunctional and lightweight components and systems for noise and heat protection. The company also provides engine and e-motor encapsulations, frunks, outer dashes, hoodliners, engine top covers, and outer trunk floor insulators; and underbody products, including under body and battery shields, wheelhouse outer liners, outer tunnel and floor insulators, battery electromagnetic shields, and heatshields.
